visual_identity.core_identity: A readable cloud of ordinary cave bats moving as one turbulent mass while individual bats remain recognizable.
visual_identity.silhouette: Many small bat silhouettes arranged in a clear directional cluster with negative space between groups.
visual_identity.head_features: Individual bats have simple pointed ears and short natural muzzles; no single face dominates.
visual_identity.body_shape: Repeated small natural bat bodies with membrane wings in varied positions; no oversized leader creature.
visual_identity.surface: Minimal fur and wing detail to prevent visual noise.
